main_text.head: PIEL.
Singularis Numerus.
Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.p: Pikked, pikkedá, pikkádta, pikkádt, pikkádti. Pikkedú, pikkadtém, pikkadtén, pikkádnu.

Verba, quæ in tertia persona singulari masculina, sub prima * hiric, dages in secunda, & ˙˙ zere, vel interdum ˉ pathah, sub eadem habent, conjugantur in Piel: Et quæ in Cal actiua sunt, hic extendunt significationem, ut, [Hebrew: אָכַל] achál comedit, [Hebrew: אֶכֵּל] ikkél, immoderate comedit.

page.notes: The Hebrew paradigm lines are transcribed as approximate vowel-pointed forms and should be checked against the scan; their exact pointing is partly illegible. The line ending "Quæ" at the right edge is cut off by the page edge, so the sentence is incomplete on this page. Marks after "prima" and "zere" ("*", "˙˙", "ˉ") are printed reference signs whose exact form is uncertain. The word "immoderate" is printed as shown. The line "Quæ" at the lower right is a catchword-like fragment that may continue onto the next page; it is kept as a paragraph here and not treated as a catchword, since it stands within the text block.
